sdt_personalization.method: SDT official user personalization: condition the pretrained writer-style generator on clean reference glyph images and generate predicted trajectories; no raster glyph splicing
sdt_personalization.dataset_note: Only the official content glyph dictionary and character list were extracted; the full approximately 6 GB CASIA dataset was not downloaded.
sdt_personalization.pilot_characters: 好我中国字的学生清风山水
sdt_personalization.pilot_result: 49 references, thresholded binary references, references resized to match official glyph occupancy, erosion, and Zhang-Suen thinning were compared on the same 12 target characters. None passed legibility and style review. Some thinned references alter generated shapes but lose the source's natural stroke weight. No pilot is integrated. The follow-up 84-reference run added 35 unique clean glyphs from page_012; outputs remained severely distorted and did not pass legibility/style review.
sdt_personalization.preprocessing_diagnostic: Style references now use 49 unique Han glyphs from three high-confidence lines. The inference loader reads numbered glyph files only and excludes the QA contact sheet. Binary and occupancy-normalized variants did not materially improve generation. The official model's documented real-world stroke-width domain gap is the likely blocker; input-only tweaks have reached diminishing returns.
sdt_personalization.next_step: Stop adding more image-only references to this unchanged pretrained model. Investigate a static-image-compatible fine-tuning path or collect online pen trajectories for the SDT training workflow; keep all generated candidates isolated until they pass the same legibility/style gate.
sdt_personalization.page_012_pilot_result: Adding 35 clean unique glyph references (84 total) changed some predicted trajectories but did not make the outputs legible. Comparison against the existing 49-reference run remains severely distorted. No weights were fine-tuned and no output was integrated.
